postings.title: Executive Assistant & Office Lead
postings.description:
We’re looking for the person who makes everything — and everyone — at Junior tick. You’ll help make our NYC office a brilliant place to work, bring people together, and keep our CTO’s day running smoothly.

This isn’t a typical Executive Assistant role. Think 80% office, people, events and culture; 20% supporting our CTO.




ABOUT JUNIOR

Junior is building an AI platform for high-stakes investment research. Our customers use it to bring expert interviews, research and AI-powered analysis together in one place — helping them make better-informed investment decisions.

We’ve grown quickly, and we’re just getting started:

 - $30M revenue run rate, with 10× revenue growth in 2025

 - Bootstrapped and profitable, with no outside investors

 - 70+ people across New York, London, Singapore, and Sydney

 - Trusted by 20 of the world’s top 30 private equity funds and 18 of the top 20 strategy consulting firms

 - Saving customers an average of 60 hours per due diligence project




ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll own the experience of working in our Flatiron office — from the everyday details that make people feel welcome to the big moments that bring the team together.

You’ll also work directly with Nico, our Co-founder and CTO, helping him stay organised and focused on the work that matters most.

No two days will look the same. You might be welcoming new engineers, planning a company offsite, organising a team dinner, or untangling a calendar puzzle. You’ll spot what needs doing and make it happen.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


MAKE OUR NYC OFFICE A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

 - Be the friendly first point of contact for our team, candidates and visitors.

 - Keep the office welcoming, organised and running smoothly.

 - Create thoughtful ways to bring people together and make office life enjoyable.

 - Own relationships with vendors, building management and service providers.


BRING PEOPLE TOGETHER

 - Organise team lunches, socials, celebrations and other events.

 - Plan company events and international off-sites, from venue research to on-the-day details.

 - Make new starters feel at home from day one.

 - Look for opportunities to make the team’s time together more fun and meaningful.


SUPPORT OUR CTO

 - Own Nico’s calendar and help him spend his time on the right priorities.

 - Coordinate meetings, travel and other logistics.

 - Keep track of important communications, follow-ups and commitments.

 - Anticipate scheduling conflicts and other issues before they become problems.

 - Build the trust to take action without needing to be asked twice.


KEEP IMPROVING HOW WE WORK

 - Coordinate office onboarding, equipment, deliveries and workplace logistics.

 - Build simple processes as the company grows.

 - Take ownership of the unexpected challenges that come with startup life — including the occasional coffee machine crisis.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you:

 - Love meeting people and making them feel welcome.

 - Take initiative and follow through without needing much direction.

 - Stay calm and organised when plans change or several things need attention at once.

 - Care about the details, from a new starter’s first day to the flow of an event.

 - Have good judgement, communicate clearly and handle sensitive information with discretion.

 - Bring ideas, a sense of humour and a genuine interest in making work better for the people around you.


EXPERIENCE WE’D LIKE TO SEE

 - 3+ years in executive assistance, office management, workplace experience, people operations or a similar role.

 - Experience organising events, off-sites or team gatherings.

 - Confidence supporting founders or senior leaders and working across teams.

 - Experience in a startup or fast-growing technology company is a plus.

 - Comfort with modern tools and finding practical ways to make work run more smoothly.

Bonus points if you’ve helped scale an office, supported a founder, or worked in AI or another fast-growing technology business. We care more about what you’ve done than the title on your LinkedIn profile.




WHY JUNIOR

You’ll have real ownership and room to shape how our NYC office works as the company grows. You’ll work closely with our founders, get to know people across the business, and have a meaningful hand in the culture we’re building.

We take building a brilliant company seriously. We don’t think that means taking ourselves too seriously.




LOGISTICS

 - Location: Flatiron, New York City

 - Working style: In office, Monday–Friday

 - Salary: $100,000–$150,000 base, depending on experience

 - Benefits: Equity, healthcare and gym benefits, breakfast and lunch in the office, and opportunities to travel for company off-sites

We’re looking for someone who makes new starters feel at home, brings people together and makes the everyday run a little better. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

postings.title: Senior Product Manager
postings.description:
ABOUT JUNIOR

Our Mission: become the ultimate intelligence layer behind every major investment decision.

Junior is building the AI intelligence platform for high-stakes investment research. We’re profitable, growing quickly and trusted by leading firms. We’re looking for a hands-on Product Manager to take important customer problems from discovery through to products people use.

 


WHAT DO WE DO?

Junior is building the AI operating system for investment research.

Private equity teams, consultants and financial institutions spend huge amounts of time gathering evidence, interviewing experts, analysing markets and turning research into decisions. Junior brings that work into one platform: from research and expert interviews to synthesis, market mapping and memo writing.

Our customers use Junior to do high-stakes work faster, while keeping the evidence connected to the output. The platform saves an average of 60 hours per due diligence project and is used by 20 of the 30 largest PE firms and 18 of the 20 leading strategy consultancies, including the likes of PwC, L.E.K., and Oliver Wyman.

We’re expanding the product into more of the work investment teams do, including investment banking, hedge funds and other research-intensive financial firms.




WHAT YOU COULD WORK ON

You’ll help build the tools investment teams use to research companies and make decisions. Current work includes:

 - Voice interviews: Build tools that help experts share useful answers, including voice interviews, better follow-up questions and more accurate transcripts.

 - Research and search: Help customers find the right facts across projects, companies and topics.

 - Slides and reports: Turn research into clear, ready-to-use slides that work with different company templates.

 - Surveys and research workflows: Make it easier to plan research, collect answers and turn them into useful results. 

 - Desktop and mobile apps: Make Junior easier to use wherever customers do their work.

 - Finance and compliance: Build tools that help finance teams sort calls and spot sensitive information.




🔥 ABOUT YOU

 - You’ve taken a product from an early idea to launch and beyond. You can explain what you owned, the choices you made, what you learned and the impact it had.

 - You have 4+ years of product experience in a fast-moving team. You’ve shipped weekly or monthly and learned from real customer use.

 - You’re close to customers. You enjoy talking with users and senior leaders, understand their needs and turn their feedback into clear priorities. You’re also comfortable joining customer calls with Sales and Customer Success.

 - You get things done. You make good trade-offs, focus on what matters for the first version and keep work moving without adding extra process.

 - You’re comfortable with technology. You’re curious about how AI products work and can use tools like Claude Code to test ideas and make quick prototypes.

 - You communicate clearly. You can explain complex ideas in simple terms, write focused product plans and give demos that make people want to use the product.

 - You’re based in New York City and happy to work from the office five days a week.

 - Bonus: You’ve worked in consulting or use AI tools regularly.




WHY JOIN NOW?

 1. The business is already working: Junior is bootstrapped, profitable and at ~$30M RRR.

 2. There’s plenty left to build: We’re expanding the product into new investment workflows while continuing to improve the core platform.

 3. You’ll own real product work: You’ll take a substantial product area from understanding the customer problem through to launch, adoption and iteration.

 4. You’ll work closely with the people building it: Product works directly with users, design, engineering, sales and customer success.

 5. The product has high stakes: Customers rely on Junior for important decisions, so accuracy, reliability and trust matter.

 6. The team is growing with the business: Junior has 75 people across New York, London and Sydney, with an expanding product team.

 7. You can see the impact: You’ll hear directly from customers and see how your decisions affect their work.




WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll join a product team with two individual-contributor PMs, working closely with the CTO, designers and engineers. You’ll also partner with sales and customer success, and speak directly with customers and users.

The team currently owns around eight product areas between them. As Junior expands its product surface, you’ll take ownership of a substantial area and help shape what gets built next.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Understand customer workflows and identify the problems worth solving.

 - Run customer discovery and speak directly with users.

 - Bring together evidence from customer conversations, demos, pilots, support and product data.

 - Set product direction and priorities for your area.

 - Scope focused MVPs and decide what needs to be excellent at launch.

 - Prototype ideas and work with Design to shape the user experience.

 - Partner with Engineering throughout development and make clear trade-offs together.

 - Define what success looks like, measure results and decide what to improve next.

 - Build adoption by understanding how customers use the product and where they get stuck.

You’ll be responsible for the product outcome, not just the roadmap or requirements document.




HOW WE WORK

 - Start with the customer: talk to users yourself and understand the work they’re trying to get done.

 - Build and learn quickly: we aim for short shipping cycles, useful feedback and regular iteration.

 - Use judgment on scope: get the details right when accuracy, reliability or customer trust is at stake. For other things, ship a focused first version and improve it with real usage.

 - Work closely with the team: Product, Design and Engineering shape solutions together.

 - Make decisions clear: explain the problem, the trade-offs and how you’ll know whether the work succeeded.

 - Use the tools available: prototype ideas with tools such as Claude Code or Codex when that helps the team explore a solution faster.




LOCATION

This role is based in New York City and works in person five days a week. Junior’s wider team is split across New York, London and Sydney.




WHAT WE OFFER

We want you to do great work, feel good while doing it and have time to recharge. Full-time employees get:

 - Real time to switch off: PTO plus a two-week office break over Christmas

 - Health cover: Medical, dental and vision coverage

 - A stronger start on retirement: A 401(k) with a 3.5% company match

 - A gym membership at Equinox

 - Good food at the office: Breakfast, lunch, snacks and drinks

 - Help with your commute: $300 per month in commuter benefits

 - Dinner and a ride home when you’re working after 8pm

 - Quarterly company off-sites each year! to the likes of Barcelona, Cancun, Texas, and Crete!




INTERESTED IN HEARING MORE?

More about Junior https://myjunior.ai/

postings.title: Head of Legal
postings.description:
ABOUT JUNIOR

We’re building cutting-edge LLM-powered workflow tools to supercharge investment research for private market investors and consultants. Our clients include most of the global top 10 private equity and consulting firms - Junior already powers hundreds of billions of dollars invested annually. We’re a profitable, bootstrapped company with a growing team of 70+ based in London, NYC and Sydney.

You can read more about the company mission & values here https://myjunior.notion.site/join-junior-2026?source=copy_link.

 


THE ROLE

This is Junior's first dedicated legal hire. You'll own the legal, regulatory and compliance function: closing our largest contracts, and building on the standards, playbooks and function that let us sell to major private equity, consulting and financial institutions. You'll work directly with the founders and sit at the centre of commercial, product, security and corporate decisions. It will suit someone who is energised by building a function from scratch.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and negotiate our most important commercial agreements: enterprise MSAs, data-processing and data-licensing terms, and security schedules with global banks, advisors and content providers. Set the standards and playbooks that let the deal team move fast without adding risk

 - Build Junior’s AI-governance and compliance posture: recording-consent and two-party-consent frameworks across jurisdictions, model-training and data-use policies, and readiness for evolving AI regulation (including the EU AI Act)

 - Run data privacy end to end (UK GDPR, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA): DPAs, records of processing, sub-processor management, and privacy-by-design partnership with Product and Engineering

 - What you’ll oversee, with the support of external counsel where necessary

 - Partner with Security/CISO on customer trust: SOC 2, security questionnaires, DPIAs and the contractual commitments behind them

 - Build and protect IP: trade-secret and patent strategy across our transcription and knowledge-graph technology, and IP terms in customer and vendor contracts

 - Manage corporate and financing legal work: governance, board and cap-table support, financing rounds, and day-to-day vendor contracting

 - Support people operations: employment matters and immigration/visa work as we scale internationally


ABOUT

 - You're admitted to a US bar. The majority of our commercial contracts are US-governed, and this is a hard requirement

 - 5-8 years of experience spanning private practice and in-house roles, with a strong transactional and commercial foundation. At least 2-4 years in practice

 - At least 2-4 years in-house experience at an AI, SaaS, or data-intensive technology company. You understand what it means to advise a business that is simultaneously a data processor and a data innovator

 - Deep expertise in data privacy: GDPR, UK GDPR, US equivalents, DPA negotiation, and subprocessor obligations. This is a recurring and substantive part of the role

 - A track record of negotiating complex B2B contracts with large institutional buyers, ideally in financial or professional services. You understand how their procurement and legal functions operate and where there is room to move

 - The ability to interpret contract language quickly and translate it into clear, actionable guidance for sales, product, and infosec colleagues. Speed and clarity matter as much as legal rigour

 - Comfortable operating as a sole legal function, with the judgment to know when to handle something internally and when to engage outside counsel

 - Strong commercial instincts. We are looking for a legal partner who helps the business move forward, not one who defaults to caution

 - UK law experience is helpful but not required. Some cross-jurisdictional awareness is important given our UK entity and global European client base
